language.label: Interface language
language.hint: Defaults to your system language; if unavailable, English is used. Affects menus, notifications, and Catrip Connect text. WhatsApp Web uses its own language.

whatsappNotice.title: WhatsApp Web uses a separate language
whatsappNotice.metaRestriction: Meta does not allow third-party apps (such as Catrip Connect) to change WhatsApp Web's language through its platform. Because of WhatsApp's usage restrictions and privacy rules, you must set the chat language manually inside WhatsApp Web.
whatsappNotice.intro: Catrip Connect's language (menus, notifications, and app text) has been updated to your selection.
whatsappNotice.step1: Open WhatsApp Web in the main window (active account).
whatsappNotice.step2: Click the ⋮ menu (three dots) at the top left and open Settings.
whatsappNotice.step3: Go to Language and choose your preferred language for WhatsApp.

scale.title: Scale
scale.hint: Affects the UI and WhatsApp Web. Applied instantly.

general.incomingLinksHint: When opening whatsapp:// or wa.me from the system.
general.registerProtocolHint: whatsapp:// — After registering, the system can open compatible links directly in Catrip.
general.checkUpdates: Check for updates on startup (GitHub Releases)
general.updateChannelHint: AppImage: downloads and installs when you restart. Installed .deb: you can download the package to a folder of your choice or open only the GitHub link; the changelog and .deb SHA-512 are shown in the dialog.
general.openDownloads: Open downloaded files with default app
general.downloadsFilenameHint: WhatsApp Web controls the file name. If the file already exists, an alternate name will be used.
general.waylandBrowserIntro: On Wayland/Linux, browsers do not hand off HTTPS links to arbitrary apps. Practical options:
general.waylandOption1: Use links that redirect to whatsapp:// (e.g. from another app or a bookmark).
general.waylandOption2: In the browser: link menu → Open with… → Catrip Connect (if listed after registering).
general.waylandOption3: A browser extension that sends wa.me URLs to the protocol (not bundled with Catrip).
general.waylandOption4: Inside the app: Ctrl+M (chat by number) or paste the link if the OS delivers it to Catrip.
general.waylandTerminal: You can also run in a terminal: npm run register:whatsapp

accounts.hint: Rename and pick an icon per account. The rail uses the same data.
accounts.deleteTitle: Delete this account and all its data
accounts.deleteWarning: The entire WhatsApp Web session will be permanently deleted (cookies, local storage, IndexedDB, Service Workers and HTTP cache). This cannot be undone.
accounts.deleteHint: To stop notifications only, disable them on the card without losing the session.

notifications.badgeSumHint: Sum unread across all accounts. Requires desktop environment support (GNOME/KDE).
notifications.manualBadgeLabel: Manual badge (test; leave empty for automatic)
notifications.riseHint: Notify when unread count increases on any account (per-account rate limit). Clicking the notification focuses the window and switches to that account.

performance.gpuInfo: Catrip Connect uses Chromium's GPU for the window, rail, and each WhatsApp Web account. On Linux the window is opaque by default (better compositing). Disable the GPU only if you see a black screen: CATRIP_DISABLE_GPU=1.
performance.gpuBoostHint: Enables reinforced rasterization, zero-copy, and extended VA-API on Linux. Restart the app after changing this or the process limit.
performance.chromiumProfileHint: Controls Chromium flags at launch (rasterization, VA-API, video). Requires an app restart. «GPU boost» elevates to aggressive when the profile stays balanced.
performance.ozonePlatformHint: Linux only. «Automatic» uses XDG_SESSION_TYPE and environment variables. You can also force it with CATRIP_OZONE_PLATFORM.
performance.suspendAfterLabel: Suspend after (minutes without using the account)
performance.suspendHint: Frees RAM by closing the WhatsApp view for unused accounts; the session (cookies) is kept. Switching back reloads instantly. While suspended, notifications for that account may not update.
performance.maxLiveAccountsHint: If you visit many accounts in one session, suspends the least recently used ones even before the idle timeout. 2 = active account + 1 in the background.
performance.prewarmOnHoverHint: After 300 ms hovering a rail account, loads WhatsApp Web in the background for a faster switch.
performance.inhibitSleepHint: Uses Electron's power save blocker (similar to portal/systemd-inhibit on Linux) while WhatsApp Web detects an active call.
performance.storageHint: Clears HTTP cache for all accounts (saves disk space; usually keeps the session).
performance.mediaDiagHint: Checks whether Chromium can play typical video/audio codecs in the active account session (same window as WhatsApp Web). Works even while you are on this settings screen.
performance.mediaDiagFootnote: If decodingInfo_mp4_h264_aac.supported is false or MediaSource rejects MP4 MIME types, audio/video in WhatsApp may fail.
performance.perfDiagHint: Memory, Chromium processes, live/suspended accounts, GPU profile, and unified heartbeat stats.
performance.perfDiagFootnote: Useful to compare before/after changing Chromium profile, suspension, or account count.

network.applyOnSaveHint: Applied when you save (no Apply button yet).
